WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, login_state, member_key AS order_member_key, status,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
lines AS (
  SELECT w.dispatch_date, f.net_amount, f.member_key AS line_member_key, w.order_member_key, w.login_state, s.store_id, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period, l.store_id, (l.category='ZZ Test') AS is_test,
  count(*) AS n, sum(l.net_amount) AS web_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN l.line_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS member_net_linekey,
  sum(CASE WHEN l.order_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS member_net_orderkey,
  sum(CASE WHEN l.login_state='logged_in' THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS member_net_login
FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.dispatch_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS m, count(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS orders_logged_in_null_line_member, min(f.sale_date) AS mn, max(f.sale_date) AS mx
FROM fact_web_order o JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
WHERE o.login_state='logged_in' AND f.member_key IS NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31'

SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(r.business_net) AS web_net_rpt
FROM (SELECT business_date, net_sales AS business_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=900) r
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
x AS (
  SELECT w.dispatch_date AS dt, f.net_amount AS v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(v) AS web_net_after_returns FROM x JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=x.dt WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, member_key AS order_member_key,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date, w.order_member_key, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.order_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_amount), 1) AS member_share_of_web_sales_pct
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.dispatch_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2
